name: Repair Jammer - DMG UP
RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's DMG UP capability.

61234.name: Repair Device I · DMG UP
61234.SpecificEffects:
When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.
In combat, the enemy's DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
